programme.desc: Scottish filmmaker and TV presenter Gordon Buchanan begins his expedition through the Gobi Desert.He decides to do it on a camel, a traditional Mongolian means of transport.An animal adapted to living in a dry and hot climate will help it survive in the wilderness, rocky plains, desert dunes and the dangerous Bumbat Mountain.Gordon wants to get to know his animal companions better.It provides them with food and benefits from the warmth of their fur.He also benefits from the hospitality of nomads who live a wandering lifestyle.The journey helps him understand that climate change has direct consequences not only for animals, but also for people who inhabit the vast steppes.

programme.title: The Jennings vs Alzheimer's
programme.desc: The documentary presents the history of the Jennings family, thanks to which it was possible to confirm the heredity of Alzheimer's disease.It all started with research conducted by the University College in London.In 1986, Professor John Hardy launched a newsletter that sought to collect reports from families with two or more cases of Alzheimer's disease.The team received many messages, but it was the one from Carol Jennings that caught their attention.In the letter, the woman described in detail the stories of her loved ones - her father, brother and sister.Each of them started showing symptoms after the age of 50.Thanks to the information provided, scientists managed to make a breakthrough in the field.
